_comment: The company's published identity — ONE source, read by every document that states it (E12-25).
JSON rather than TypeScript so a plain .mjs script can read it too: the website renderer, the
app's generated policy documents and the placeholder register all substitute from this file,
and a value that lives in only one of them is the drift this file exists to prevent.
null means genuinely unknown. It is never substituted, so its «TOKEN» survives into the
rendered document and a production build refuses to publish it.
_effectiveDates: Fixed, never computed. An effective date that moves with each build is not an effective date.
